description: UPL - Mejoramiento red peatonal. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. En una zona delimitada consolida una red con mecanismos de pacificación de tráfico, mejora y reconstruye franjas de circulación peatonal para personas con discapacidad y en riesgo y peatones. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Bogotá DC, Decreto 555 de 2021, Formulación, Norma Urbana, POT. It offers 5 resource(s) in DXF, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2024-10-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
